text: Churned like any cream, but the whey cream is thinner and saltier, so the butter has its own flavour. No churning temperatures were found in a source I opened.

steps.note: The cream undergoes heat treatment to kill harmful bacteria like Listeria, Salmonella and E. coli.
The cream is held for several hours before churning.
The cream is kept warm for at least 2 to 4 hours, then cooled gradually to 6–8 °C, which sets the fat.

sources.text: The cream-to-butter steps and the whey-cream remark are from Agroscope; the whey cream (25–30 % fat) and its use for butter from Tetra Pak. Neither gives parameters for whey cream alone, so those are the general ones for butter cream.
